What role does the "KV cache transfer" parameter play in GPU autoscaling?  
The "KV cache transfer" parameter is used to manage the transfer of key-value pairs between the GPU and the CPU. This is important for optimizing data access and reducing latency.

Prefill pressure refers to the amount of data that needs to be loaded into the GPU before the request starts. High prefill pressure can lead to increased GPU utilization and may require adjustments in autoscaling strategies.  

What is the main goal of the "GPU scheduling" parameter in the context of autoscaling?  
The "GPU scheduling" parameter ensures that tasks are executed in an optimal order to maximize efficiency and minimize idle time. Proper scheduling is crucial for maintaining performance during autoscaling.  

What is the purpose of the "autoscaling" strategy in the context of GPU resource management?  
The "autoscaling" strategy is used to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on the workload. This allows the system to respond to changes in demand and maintain optimal performance.
